Avision GmbH | Full Stack Developer (Java + Angular/React) | Remote (Germany) | Full-time

We're modernizing old business software in relatively small teams.

Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Angular or React, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes. GitLab CI/CD, Gradle and Maven are a plus.

We want: 2+ years with Spring Boot and Angular/React, solid SQL, German at B2 or better.

We offer: fully remote within Germany, 32 vacation days, flexible hours, overtime paid out or taken as time off, Windows or Linux laptop, sabbatical and workation options.

Send me an e-mail and I can give you a referral if I think you deserve it. Otherwise apply through the website.
